ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var html = String(result);
var re = /<a[^>]+href="(\/article\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g;
var m, seen = {}, arr = [];
while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
  var id = parseInt(m[3], 10);
  if (seen[id]) { continue; }
  seen[id] = 1;
  var nm = m[4].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (nm.length < 1) { continue; }
  if (nm === '开始阅读') { nm = '第1章'; }
  arr.push({i: id, name: nm, url: 'https://www.bqg24.com/article/' + m[2] + '/' + m[3] + '.html'});
}
arr.sort(function (a, b) { return a.i - b.i; });
var out = [];
for (var k = 0; k < arr.length; k++) { out.push({name: arr[k].name, url: arr[k].url}); }
JSON.stringify(out)
</js>
